The '''Kavarthen Wars''' were a series of conflicts that began sometime during the reign of the [[Brown Ajah|Brown]] [[Amyrlin Seat]] [[Balladare Arandaille]], and possibly ended during her reign or continued into the reign of her successor, [[Medanor Eramandos]]. Apart from this information, nothing is known about the war.{{ref/book|12|16}}
